business_scope.primary_industry_name: Statutory Company Secretarial and Commercial Registered Agent Office

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Panama (Republic of Panama) – unitary national jurisdiction, no sub-state tax distinction
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid: Civil Law base with strongly Anglo-American corporate law overlay (Ley 32 de 1927 modeled on Delaware corporate statutes)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Trade Promotion Agreement between Panama and the United States of America (in force, 2012)
Convention between Panama and the Kingdom of the Netherlands for the Avoidance of Double Taxation (in force, 2000)
Convention between Panama and the Republic of Singapore for the Avoidance of Double Taxation (in force, 2018)
Convention between Panama and the Kingdom of Spain for the Avoidance of Double Taxation (in force, 2012)
United Nations Convention against Corruption (UNCAC) and Inter-American Convention against Corruption (ratified)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 (AML/CFT framework); Ley 254 de 21 de octubre de 2021 (Beneficial Ownership Registry) and Decreto Ejecutivo No. 110 de 2022 (implementing regulations); Decreto Ejecutivo No. 522 de 2016 (registered agent shareholder ledger); UAF Resolución General de Debida Diligencia No. 001-2016; Código de Comercio arts. 87-99 and Ley 32 de 1927 (Sociedad Anónima regime)
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access: Registro de Beneficiarios Finales is confidential, accessible only by DGI, UAF and judicial authorities; the registered agent's shareholder ledger under D.E. 522/2016 is Private_Internal

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Sworn declaration of beneficial owner (Declaración Jurada de Beneficiario Final) per Ley 254 de 2021
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Subscriber/UBO before a Notary Public in country of origin, countersigned by the Panama registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization + Hague Apostille (for Apostille Convention states) OR Consular Legalization at a Panama consulate for non-Hague states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Special Power of Attorney (Poder Especial) appointing the Panama law firm / licensed resident agent for incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the principal's jurisdiction of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport of each shareholder, director and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing passport authority or Notary Public in country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference and source-of-funds letter (Comprobante de fondos/origen lícito) for each UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Banker's certification plus Hague Apostille/Consular Legalization where required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing of any corporate shareholder (Certificado de Existencia y Vigencia)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based Customer Due Diligence under Ley 23 de 2015 and UAF Resolution No. 001-2016: legal entity and every UBO must be screened against (i) OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List; (ii) United Nations Security Council Consolidated List; (iii) EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List; (iv) UAF national terrorist and terror-financing list; (v) domestic PEP, corruption and tax fraud registers. PEPs (national and foreign) require enhanced due diligence, written senior-management approval, and source-of-wealth/source-of-funds evidence before onboarding.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá – Departamento de Registro Mercantil / Sistema de Reserva y Consulta de Nombres en Línea (https://www.registro-publico.gob.pa)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be expressed in Spanish or in Latin-alphabet romanization; non-Latin scripts must be transliterated into the Spanish/Latin alphabet; the name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name and must end with 'Sociedad Anónima' or the abbreviation 'S.A.'
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Name reservations are not extendable; expiry requires a new filing. Where the Registry rejects a name (including reserved token usage), the applicant or the licensed resident agent may file a written Recurso de Apelación with the Director General del Registro Público within five (5) business days of notification, attaching alternative name options and supporting evidence that the rejected denominator is not misleading nor protected by another holder; a rejected applicant may simultaneously submit up to three (3) revised alternative names for expedited clearance.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted as the statutory registered seat: every Sociedad Anónima must maintain a registered office in Panama through a licensed resident agent; virtual/telework sub-back-office functions are allowed only if the physical Panama office and complete statutory records remain available to Registro Público, DGI and UAF authorities
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 15-20% quantified risk: moderate likelihood of unannounced on-site visits by UAF (AML compliance audits), DGI (tax/fiscal substance verification), and municipal inspectors verifying the Aviso de Operación and office occupation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per UAF due-diligence standards

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified copies, legal stamps and archive/courier for pre-incorporation dossier
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registro Público de Panamá / law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory certification fees and prevailing disbursement market rates

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley General de Sociedades, Ley 32 de 1927, as amended (Title I: Constitution, Articles 1-3; Title II: Registered Office, Article 12; Title IV: Share Capital, Article 29)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección de Personas Jurídicas (Public Registry of Panama, Legal Entities Section)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución de Sociedad Anónima (Public Deed of Incorporation)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital; one or more shares must be subscribed and paid as determined by the incorporators; no escrow account requirement
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation’s Articles of Incorporation registered under Record ... are hereby approved; that the share subscription and initial capital contributions are accepted; that the registered office as stated in the Articles is adopted; and that [Name] is appointed President, [Name] as Secretary-Treasurer, and [Registered Agent Name] as Resident Agent, each to serve until successors are elected. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the officers are authorized to open bank accounts, execute agreements, and complete all statutory filings relating to incorporation and licensing. PASSED unanimously.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Reservation and Pre-registry Due Diligence
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Departamento de Nombre y Registro
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a written name reservation request on the registry’s prescribed form, stating the proposed corporate name and the intended purpose. Pay the certificate fee and obtain the Certificado de Nombre (Name Certificate). Verify that no identical or confusingly similar name is already registered.
required_dossiers: Copy of the applicant’s or incorporator’s valid passport or ID
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, submit an amended name reservation with alternative names and reapply within 3 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of the Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public of the Circuito (Panama City Notary) and firm-administrator legal counsel
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct legal counsel to draft the Escritura de Constitución, specifying the corporate name, registered office, share classes, capital structure, incorporators’ details, and the appointed resident agent. Appear before the Notary Public for protocolization, execute the deed, and obtain the notarized original.
required_dossiers: Proof of identity of each incorporator
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies defects, correct the deed text and re-execute before the same notary or another; no registry penalty is incurred if corrected before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of the Escritura de Constitución at the Public Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección de Personas Jurídicas
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized Escritura de Constitución together with a formal registration request and the resident agent’s sworn compliance letter. Pay the registration and official stamp fees. Obtain the certified registry filing certificate (Certificado de Registro Público) confirming legal existence.
required_dossiers: Payment receipts for registry and stamp fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues an objection or request for correction, file an amendment (Protocolización de Rectificación) within 10 business days and resubmit the corrected deed for final registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the newly formed corporation for Panama Tax ID (RUC) using the certified registry certificate and the officers’ identification documents. Complete the DGI forms to declare the territorial tax filing basis and the entity’s business purpose. Obtain the RUC certificate.
required_dossiers: Copy of the Escritura de Constitución
DGI RUC form and supporting declarations
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DGI queries the background information, provide additional corporate documents and officer powers; respond within 5 business days to avoid temporary suspension of registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Operating License and Local Business Endorsement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Alcaldía de Panamá – Secretaría de Atención al Contribuyente
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the municipal Aviso de Operación (Operating License) for the commercial activity “Servicios de Secretaría Corporativa y Agencia Residente”. Submit the RUC certificate, registry certificate, lease evidence of the Panama office, and fire safety inspection report. Pay the municipal fee and receive the annual operating license.
required_dossiers: Lease or title evidence of the registered office
Municipal application form and fee receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality rejects the application for missing structural load or occupancy clearance, obtain the necessary building certification and resubmit within 7 business days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) – Dirección General de Empresas
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operación para Servicios de Secretaría Corporativa y Agente Residente (Commercial Operating License for Company Secretarial and Resident Agent Services)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Categoría I – Registro Ambiental (Basic environmental registration; no full EIA required for administrative office-only activities)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Panamanian air quality and wastewater discharge limits applicable to office operations; no process emissions generated; waste must be segregated and handled through licensed haulers under Resolution AG-0746-2018

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Dirección Nacional de Protección Civil (SINAPROC) and municipal structural load/occupancy inspection for the registered office; workplace occupational safety risk assessment per Panama Decreto Ejecutivo No. 52 de 2013

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas; taxpayer portal: DGI Sede Electrónica via https://dgi.mef.gob.pa (e-Tax Panama)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity must obtain a Registro Único de Contribuyente (RUC) before invoicing Panamanian-source revenue. The application is filed before DGI through a local registered agent or an apostilled power of attorney, and must include corporate registration documents, beneficial ownership declaration, and a description of intended economic activities. Non-resident entities without a permanent establishment require a RUC only if they generate Panama-source income subject to ITBMS or corporate income tax.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Panama does not provide a US-style check-the-box election. A Panamanian Sociedad Anónima is inherently classified as a territorial taxpayer taxed on Panama-source income only. No statutory hybrid mismatch election exists; affiliated groups may elect consolidated filing under DGI administrative authorisation where wholly-owned groups meet statutory conditions.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Impuesto sobre la Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios – ITBMS)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: None (registration is mandatory upon the first taxable act; no monetary turnover threshold exists. A simplified monthly-payment regime is available for eligible micro/small taxpayers).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Panama mandates digital invoicing ('Facturación Electrónica') through the DGI e-Tax platform. After a phased taxpayer-by-taxpayer rollout, all registered ITBMS taxpayers must issue digital invoices bearing a validated QR code and a DGI-generated authorization number. Invoices are transmitted in near real-time through the DGI API or web portal; fiscal authorization is obtained before serial activation and each emission is validated by a digital stamping service against the taxpayer's active registration status.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is available when the exporter proves (i) movable goods physically left Panama under a valid customs export declaration, or (ii) services were rendered exclusively for use or consumption outside Panama and were received and paid by a non-resident without economic benefit in Panama. The exporter must maintain an active RUC, be registered for ITBMS, and issue an electronic invoice that expressly identifies the export nature of the transaction.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Panama Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación) validated by the National Customs Authority (ANA)
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, or equivalent transport document evidencing physical departure from Panama
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank deposit voucher proving payment in USD to the Panama-based exporter
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent export zero-rating is subject to retrospective reassessment by DGI within the general five-year limitation period (extended to ten years in the case of fraud). The tax authority may claw back all input ITBMS credits previously offset against zero-rated exports, and impose fines of up to 200% of the omitted ITBMS, plus monthly interest and late-payment surcharges. Misdeclared exports also trigger suspension of the RUC, revocation of export authorisation, and potential criminal liability for tax fraud under Panamanian fiscal and criminal legislation.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) — statutory banking, trust and financial-services regulator; note that Panama does not maintain a central bank, and the US dollar is legal tender under a full dollarization system.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility without capital controls. The Panamanian balboa circulates at a fixed 1:1 exchange rate with the US dollar, and the US dollar itself is legal tender. Non-resident corporations face no exchange-control permit, no central bank approval, and no current- or capital-account restrictions on profit remittances, dividends, loan repayments, service fees, or registered-agent payments. The only frictions are AML/CFT reporting thresholds, bank-level due diligence, and documentary requirements imposed by SBP Rule 8-2017 and the FATF recommendations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Panama imposes no statutory export-proceeds surrender requirement. There is no mandatory conversion ratio, no repatriation timeline, and no requirement to channel export settlements through local banks. Export receipts and all other inbound funds may be freely retained in USD or any convertible currency, subject to general AML/CFT record-keeping and suspicious-transaction reporting duties.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Banco Nacional de Panamá (state-owned commercial bank)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium. Offshore electronic money institutions holding an EU/UK EMI license cannot passport into Panama. To offer local settlement, an EMI must either (i) establish a correspondent relationship with an SBP-licensed bank, (ii) operate through a local licensed bank under the SBP outsourcing rules, or (iii) apply for a non-bank financial-services authorization (electronic-money issuer / casa de valor) from the SBP. In practice, cross-border EMIs are accepted only as payment-introducer or payout-routing channels into a Panamanian omnibus account; the final treasury settlement must occur at a licensed local bank. Enhanced KYC, local registered-agent presence, and transactional reporting to the SBP are legally required.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors and ultimate beneficial owners are not statutorily required to appear in person for corporate-account opening if the bank accepts apostilled, notarized or certified KYC packages; each tier-1 bank applies a risk-based approach under SBP Rule 8-2017. For a Panama-registered non-resident S.A. engaged in registered-agent/offshore secretarial services, most tier-1 banks will require at least one live interview (by video or in person) with the UBO or an authorized director. Remote opening is feasible when the company has local substance, the UBO is an existing bank client, or a reputable licensed introducer performs the interview. Enhanced due diligence is triggered if the bank identifies nominee arrangements, high-risk foreign tax residencies, or unexplained source of wealth.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident private interest foundation (PIF) or company with multi-layer shareholding, nominee directors, and unclear ultimate beneficial ownership.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized and apostilled certificate of incorporation and foundation charter; certified copy of corporate registry entry (Registro Público de Panamá); full UBO chain with copies of passports; sworn source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statements; bank and professional references from jurisdictions of the principals; notarized board resolutions confirming the purpose; corporate good-standing certificate from the licensed registered agent.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume cross-border wire traffic to or from jurisdictions perceived as high-risk, inconsistent with a staff outsourcing / secretarial-services business model.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed business narrative describing the exact outsourced services; signed client service agreements and sub-contracting contracts; in-house AML risk assessment of the client portfolio; transaction flow diagrams explaining each payment leg; client on-boarding CDD records; billing and invoicing trail; evidence that all wire purpose codes match the commercial reality of the transaction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large unexplained inbound capital injection into a capital escrow or operational account shortly after incorporation, particularly if the company has no prior operating history.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized capital subscription or contribution resolution; audited or management financial statements of the contributing party; bank statements of the remitting entity showing the origin of funds; declaration of non-repayable equity contribution; loan agreements if injected as shareholder debt; tax or fiscal-clearance certificates where applicable; legal opinion confirming that the company is not a dormant shell and that the capital will support active cross-border secretarial operations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of crypto/fintech payment rails or settlement through a high-risk correspondent jurisdiction for a Panama private interest foundation or registered-agent fee collections.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete source-of-funds documentation from the ultimate payor; chain-of-title records showing each intermediary transfer; settlement confirmation from a licensed Panamanian bank; client KYC/AML file with beneficial-ownership attestation; a local legal certificate addressing FATF and SBP Rule 8-2017 compliance; in-force letter of good standing issued by the licensed registered agent.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing uses SWIFT MT103 or FedWire transfers to the bank's USD correspondent (abstractly, the Panama branch or its US correspondent), referencing the corporate RUC and, where applicable, the PIF registration number. Narrative must specify 'Capital contribution — non-repayable equity injection' and include the ultimate-stockholder name and tax identification (CRS/TIN). Equity injections should be directed into a dedicated Capital Escrow Account at the receiving SBP-licensed bank and must align with a notarized capital resolution previously presented at onboarding. The receiving bank registers the receipt under the capital-transaction code for national statistics and applies enhanced due diligence, including verification of the dispatching bank's licensing status and the transaction purpose.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails for outbound settlements: (i) SWIFT MT103 for cross-border fees, service payments, dividends and management fees; (ii) commercial letters of credit under ICC UCP 600 using MT700/MT710/MT202 series where goods or invoiced services require title transfer; (iii) Panama's local ACH (ACH Panama / Cámara de Compensación) for USD-denominated domestic payments; (iv) cheques or straight wires for low-value disbursements. For an ISIC 8299 registered-agent and secretarial office, outward flows are predominantly operating expenses, statutory fees, dividends, and intra-group charges; every payment must be supported by an underlying contract, invoice, board resolution, and CRS/FATCA self-certification to satisfy the bank's travel-rule and suspicious-transaction monitoring obligations.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable US-dollar forward contracts on the offshore interbank market where a local counterparty is available
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on Latin American currency crosses for mismatched foreign-currency receivables or payables
Cross-currency interest rate swaps and FX swaps to align USD functional-currency cash flows
Vanilla currency options (puts and calls) executed through an SBP-licensed bank or authorized securities broker-dealer solely for treasury hedging, not speculative trading

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax (Pago Anual de Sociedad Anónima)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 of each calendar year for the preceding fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% monthly surcharge up to 60%, compensatory interest, coercive debt collection proceedings, and denial of the certificate of good standing; continued default may lead the registered agent to resign as an intermediary.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Certified Updated Corporate Books Affidavit (notarized for internal files, not filed)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Maintained in the custody of the registered agent / registered office; available for inspection by DGI and AML authorities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: To be completed no later than April 30 for the prior fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance exposes the corporation to fines under Law 23 of 2015 and to administrative sanctions against the resident agent.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit is required if annual gross revenue exceeds USD 3,000,000 or total assets exceed USD 3,000,000; lower thresholds may apply if the company is active in regulated financial services, or if required by the DGI.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB for public-interest and consolidated entities; Local GAAP (PCGA Panamá) for private limited companies is accepted when not a regulated entity.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must annually review and update the UBO register maintained in the corporate books; shareholders and directors must submit written confirmation containing all changes in shareholding or beneficial ownership. No public UBO return is filed, but records must be available for immediate examination by the Superintendencia de Sujetos No Financieros and DGI.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Share Transfers and Beneficial Owners (Law 23 of 2015)
